name: MMGIS
description: Multi-Mission Geographic Information System - A Web-based Mapping and Spatial Data Infrastructure for Earth, Lunar and Planetary Visualization, Research, Science, Planning and Operations.

paragraphs: A free, open source and easily configurable solution for GIS on the web. Run MMGIS via a prebuilt docker image on your server and use the Configure page to setup a new mission map to get started. You completely own your data too but are responsible for any data processing (though provided are a variety of scripts and organization methods to help do so and jump off from)
MSL Curiosity Rover · InSight · Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover · Mars Helicopter (Ingenuity) · EMIT · MAIA · BioSCape · FireSense · Lunar VIPER · MGViz · SHIFT · FROZON · Where is the Rover · and more!
features: 2D/3D rendering - Leaflet-based 2D maps and Cesium/Lithosphere-powered 3D globes with synchronized views
Immersive viewers - High-resolution imagery viewer, photospheres, 3D models, PDFs, and videos
Custom projections - Support for planetary projections and custom coordinate systems
Terrain visualization - Tiled height data generation
10 layer types - Vector, Tile, Image, Model, Vectortile, Velocity, Video, Data, Header, and Query layers
